# KokonutUI - Component Registry Index

Collection of 57 UI components free and open source built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and Motion.

Install any component with: npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/<component-name>

Agents can also browse and install components through the shadcn MCP server
(npx shadcn@latest mcp) once the @kokonutui registry is configured in
components.json. Setup guide: https://kokonutui.com/docs/mcp

The documentation index for LLMs lives at https://kokonutui.com/llms.txt

## Components

- [Action Search Bar](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/action-search-bar.md): Search bar with debounced input, shortcut hints, and an animated action suggestions dropdown, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/action-search-bar`
- [AI Input Search](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-input-search.md): AI search chat input with toggleable web search mode, file attachment and auto-resizing textarea. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-input-search`
- [AI Input Selector](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-prompt.md): AI chat input with a model picker, file chips you can drop or paste, and Stop while replying. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-prompt`
- [AI State Loading](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-loading.md): Animated AI loading state cycling task statuses through a scrolling code-style log with an SVG progress spinner. Built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-loading`
- [AI Text Loading](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-text-loading.md): Animated AI thinking indicator that cycles status messages with a shimmering gradient text effect. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-text-loading`
- [AI Voice](https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-voice.md): Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-voice`
- [Apple Activity Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/apple-activity-card.md): Animated activity rings card inspired by the Apple Fitness app, with progress circles built in React using Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/apple-activity-card`
- [Avatar Picker](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/avatar-picker.md): Animated avatar picker with SVG avatar options, colored selection ring and username input. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/avatar-picker`
- [Background Paths](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/background-paths.md): A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/background-paths`
- [Beams Background](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/beams-background.md): Animated background of drifting light beams rendered on an HTML canvas with configurable intensity. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/beams-background`
- [Bento Grid](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/bento-grid.md): Responsive bento grid of feature cards with a spotlight list, a typing code snippet, logos, a timeline and a voice widget, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/bento-grid`
- [Card Flip](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/card-flip.md): Interactive card that flips in 3D on hover to reveal features and a call to action, built with React and Tailwind CSS transforms and transitions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/card-flip`
- [Carousel Cards](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/carousel-cards.md): Horizontally scrolling card carousel with ratings, badges and arrow navigation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui primitives. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/carousel-cards`
- [Command Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/command-button.md): Keyboard shortcut button with a Command icon, hover shimmer sweep, and smooth CSS transitions, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/command-button`
- [Currency Transfer](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/currency-transfer.md): Currency exchange status card with animated progress and a drawn checkmark on completion, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/currency-transfer`
- [Detent Dial](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/detent-dial.md): Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/detent-dial`
- [Drape Background](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/drape-background.md): A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/drape-background`
- [Dynamic Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/dynamic-text.md): Animated text switcher that cycles through greetings in multiple languages, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion enter and exit transitions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/dynamic-text`
- [File Upload](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/file-upload.md): Drag and drop file upload with animated progress, file validation and error states. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/file-upload`
- [Flow Field](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/flow-field.md): Canvas particle flow field background with noise-driven streams of glowing light, color themes and density options. Built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/flow-field`
- [Glitch Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/glitch-text.md): Customizable glitch text effect with adjustable intensity, colors and sizes, animated in React with Motion and styled with Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/glitch-text`
- [Gradient Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/gradient-button.md): Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, a gradient border in light and dark mode, soft inner glow, press feedback, and an optional icon, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/gradient-button`
- [Hold Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/hold-button.md): Press-and-hold confirmation button with an animated progress fill, configurable hold duration, and color variants, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/hold-button`
- [Liquid Gauge](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/liquid-gauge.md): A usage meter filled with liquid that sloshes, ripples and bubbles, built with React and a wave simulation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/liquid-gauge`
- [Liquid Glass](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/liquid-glass-card.md): Apple-inspired liquid glass card and buttons using SVG displacement filters for a refractive effect, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/liquid-glass-card`
- [Liquid Slider](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/liquid-slider.md): A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/liquid-slider`
- [Loader](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/loader.md): Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/loader`
- [Magnet Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/attract-button.md): Magnetic button that pulls floating particles to its center on hover using Motion spring animations, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/attract-button`
- [Marking Menu](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/marking-menu.md): A radial menu you hold to open or flick to pick blind, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/marking-menu`
- [Matrix Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/matrix-text.md): Matrix-style text effect where letters scramble through binary characters before revealing, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/matrix-text`
- [Morphic Navbar](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/morphic-navbar.md): Navigation bar whose active link morphs into a rounded pill with smooth CSS transitions, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/morphic-navbar`
- [Mouse Effect Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/mouse-effect-card.md): Interactive card with an animated dot pattern that repels away from the cursor, powered by React, Tailwind CSS and Motion spring physics. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/mouse-effect-card`
- [Notification Stack](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/notification-stack.md): Stacked notifications that fan out on hover and swipe away, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/notification-stack`
- [Particle Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/particle-button.md): Button that bursts animated particles from its center on click with a quick scale press effect, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/particle-button`
- [Plucked Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/plucked-text.md): A headline sitting on a string you can pluck, strum and let ring, built with React and real string physics. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/plucked-text`
- [Profile Dropdown](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/profile-dropdown.md): User profile dropdown menu with avatar, subscription and model details, and quick action links, built with React, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/profile-dropdown`
- [Pull Cord](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/pull-cord.md): A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/pull-cord`
- [Scroll Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/scroll-text.md): Scroll-driven text list that highlights the active word as you scroll, using IntersectionObserver with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/scroll-text`
- [Shape Hero](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/shape-hero.md): A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/shape-hero`
- [Shimmer Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/shimmer-text.md): Animated shimmer text with a looping gradient sweep across the letters, built with React and Tailwind CSS gradients and keyframes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/shimmer-text`
- [Sliced Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/sliced-text.md): Text effect that splits into two offset slices and merges together on hover using clip-path, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/sliced-text`
- [Slide Text Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/slide-text-button.md): Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/slide-text-button`
- [Smooth Drawer](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/smooth-drawer.md): Bottom drawer with spring-based slide-in and staggered content reveal, built on Vaul with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/smooth-drawer`
- [Smooth Tab](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/smooth-tab.md): Animated tab switcher with a sliding active indicator and smooth card content transitions, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/smooth-tab`
- [Social Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/social-button.md): Share button that expands into a row of social icon buttons with staggered Motion animations on hover, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/social-button`
- [Spotlight Cards](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/spotlight-cards.md): Feature card grid with ambient aurora glow, magnetic 3D tilt and focus dimming on hover, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion springs. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/spotlight-cards`
- [Stack](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/card-stack.md): Stack of product cards that expands on click to reveal details and specs, animated with Motion and styled with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/card-stack`
- [Switch Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/switch-button.md): Light and dark theme toggle button with a rotating sun icon and shimmer hover effect, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Works on its own or with a theme provider such as next-themes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/switch-button`
- [Swoosh Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/swoosh-text.md): Hover text effect with layered colorful shadows that snap flat on mouseover, built with React and Tailwind CSS transitions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/swoosh-text`
- [Team Selector](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/team-selector.md): Animated team size selector with stacked overlapping avatars, spring transitions and increment controls. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/team-selector`
- [Tear Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/tear-button.md): A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/tear-button`
- [Toolbar](https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/toolbar.md): Figma-inspired toolbar where the selected tool expands to reveal its label with spring animations, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/toolbar`
- [Topo Background](https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/topo-background.md): A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/topo-background`
- [Typing Text](https://kokonutui.com/docs/texts/type-writer.md): Typewriter text animation that types and deletes multiple sequences with a blinking cursor and auto loop, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/type-writer`
- [V0 Button](https://kokonutui.com/docs/buttons/v0-button.md): Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/v0-button`
- [Wheel Picker](https://kokonutui.com/docs/inputs/wheel-picker.md): iOS-style 3D drum picker with flick momentum, built with React and Motion. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/wheel-picker`
- [X Card](https://kokonutui.com/docs/cards/tweet-card.md): X (Twitter) style post card with author details, verified badge, reply thread and hover gradient, built with React and Tailwind CSS. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/tweet-card`
